languageData.AmorQueenXenotype.label: Amor Queen
languageData.AmorQueenXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Queen. Incubates and lays Amor Brood Mother eggs while also producing Tentacle Slime.
languageData.AmorQueenXenotype.descriptionShort: A female Host who creates Brood Mother eggs and Tentacle Slime.
languageData.AmorBaronessXenotype.label: Amor Baroness
languageData.AmorBaronessXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Baroness. Carries Amor Squirmer tentacles and can transfer them to other Hosts.
languageData.AmorBaronessXenotype.descriptionShort: A female Host who carries Amor Squirmer tentacles for other Hosts.
languageData.AmorNymphXenotype.label: Amor Nymph
languageData.AmorNymphXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Nymph. Uses Amor Squirmers to subdue hostile pawns and calm allies in a mental break.
languageData.AmorNymphXenotype.descriptionShort: A female Host who subdues enemies and placates allies.
languageData.AmorBaronXenotype.label: Amor Baron
languageData.AmorBaronXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Baron. Acts as a defender for the colony, and mobile storage for Amor Squirmer tentacles.
languageData.AmorBaronXenotype.descriptionShort: A male Host who supports and protects other hosts.
languageData.AmorRogueXenotype.label: Amor Rogue
languageData.AmorRogueXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Rogue. Uses Amor Squirmers to temporarily turn invisible and ambush enemies.
languageData.AmorRogueXenotype.descriptionShort: A male Host who stalks and ambushes enemies.
languageData.AmorKnightXenotype.label: Amor Knight
languageData.AmorKnightXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Knight. Acts as the primary fighter, storing and using Amor Squirmers to excel at close-quarters combat.
languageData.AmorKnightXenotype.descriptionShort: A male Host who subdues enemies through sheer strengh.
languageData.AmorServantXenotype.label: Amor Servant
languageData.AmorServantXenotype.description: A human Host that has been genetically modified into an Amor Servant. Acts as the primary worker, specializing in crafting-related work.
languageData.AmorServantXenotype.descriptionShort: A male Host who excels at labor-related tasks.
